content.title: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Solana payment

Solana payments represent a revolutionary shift in how digital products can be sold. Unlike conventional platforms that impose high fees and restrictive policies, Solana enables creators to accept payments directly in cryptocurrency, significantly reducing transaction costs. NOWPayments, for instance, charges only 0.5% per transaction compared to the 10% fee that platforms like Gumroad impose. This reduction in fees can lead to substantial revenue retention, making it a game-changer for creators looking to maximize their income.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The architecture behind Solana payments for digital products involves combining several key technologies. Using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, you can automate the delivery of digital products upon payment confirmation through NOWPayments. This setup not only ensures seamless transactions but also grants you full ownership of your data and infrastructure. By leveraging free tools like GitHub Pages for hosting and Supabase for order management, you can build a robust digital commerce stack that operates independently of traditional platforms.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This infrastructure is specifically designed for digital creators in regions facing payment processing limitations. Whether you are selling ebooks, courses, or templates, the Solana payment system empowers you to transact directly with your customers. By eliminating reliance on platforms that charge excessive fees, you can focus on creating and selling without the constant worry of losing a significant portion of your earnings to platform fees, ensuring that creators in markets like Kenya, Ghana, and Venezuela can thrive.
Retain more of your revenue by drastically reducing transaction fees.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The successful implementation of Solana payments for digital products relies on several interconnected components. You need a hosting solution, such as GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, for your website. For backend logic, Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script can automate interactions with NOWPayments, which verifies transactions in real-time. Additionally, using Supabase or Google Sheets for order management ensures you have a reliable database for tracking sales and customer details. Each component is essential for creating a functional and efficient digital commerce system.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To start utilizing Solana payments for your digital products, begin by setting up your website on a free hosting platform like GitHub Pages. Next, integrate NOWPayments for accepting cryptocurrency by following their documentation. Then, automate product delivery using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. Finally, track orders using Supabase or Google Sheets. For a comprehensive guide, explore the Complete Builder Kit ($197) which includes all necessary blueprints and templates to help you deploy your own sovereign digital commerce stack.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

To sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe, consider using cryptocurrency payment processors like NOWPayments. This solution allows you to accept payments directly in crypto, avoiding traditional platform fees. With just a small fee of 0.5%, you retain more of your earnings, enabling you to maximize profits from each sale.
Own your data and infrastructure — no more platform locks.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

Every digital product type — ebook, course, template, font, preset, beat, plugin, software license — works with the same sovereign commerce infrastructure. You build the product. NOWPayments handles the checkout. Your backend handles the delivery. You keep 99.5% of every sale. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 has COREMERCH deploy the complete stack under your accounts in 48 hours. The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 gives you everything you need to build it yourself. Both paths lead to a store you own completely. See both at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Build your product before you build your store — the product is the point, not the infrastructure. Once your product is ready and in delivery-ready format, create your NOWPayments account and configure wallet addresses. Choose Stack 01 for self-deployment following the Blueprint, or Stack 02 for COREMERCH deployment. Upload your product file to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 and note the file path. Configure the product in your backend with the file path, USD price, and delivery email template. Build your product page on the storefront with clear product description, pricing in USD, and the checkout flow. Run a complete mainnet test. Check that the download link works and expires correctly after the configured time period.
Frequently Asked Questions
How can I accept payments in cryptocurrency?

To accept payments in cryptocurrency, integrate NOWPayments into your website. It allows you to receive payments in over 300 cryptocurrencies with minimal fees. You can easily set this up using their API, which provides detailed instructions.
What are the benefits of using Solana for payments?

Solana offers fast transaction speeds and low fees, making it ideal for processing payments for digital products. By using Solana, you can ensure that your transactions are completed quickly, improving customer satisfaction.
Can I sell digital products without high platform fees?
Yes, by using NOWPayments and a self-hosted solution, you can significantly reduce or eliminate platform fees. This setup allows you to keep more of your earnings and control your sales process.
What types of digital products can I sell?

You can sell various digital products like ebooks, courses, templates, fonts, presets, beats, and plugins. The flexibility of the infrastructure allows you to customize your offerings based on your audience's needs.
Is there ongoing support for the deployment?
Yes, when you purchase the Complete Builder Kit, you receive access to support resources to assist you with deployment and troubleshooting as you build and scale your digital commerce stack.
